# Vacuum-salt plant, vapour recompression evaporator: data sheet

REAL DESIGN DATA from US Patent 5,366,514 (Texas Brine Corp., 1994), FIG. I and Table I: a 2,500 short-ton-per-day
plant making 99.99 % NaCl from solution-mined brine. The P&ID was drawn by PlantAgent on that flowsheet (tags, line
numbers, valves and relief settings are ours). Equipment ratings marked ILLUSTRATIVE are not in the patent.

## Operating point (patent Table I, converted to SI)
| Stream / item | Value |
|---|---|
| Feed brine to E-101 (line 1001), "saturated in salt" (about 26 wt % NaCl) | 362.9 t/h at 24 °C |
| Brine leaving E-101 | 60 °C |
| Elutriating brine to the evaporator legs | 98.0 t/h at 60 °C |
| Brine through E-102 to V-201 (lines 1003/1004) | 264.9 t/h, 60 → 125.6 °C |
| V-201 VRC evaporator | 1.70 bar(a) (10 psig), brine boiling at 125.6 °C |
| V-201 overhead to K-201 (line 3001) | 226.8 t/h steam, saturation 115.2 °C at 1.70 bar(a) |
| K-201 discharge | 3.08 bar(a) (30 psig), pressure ratio 1.8 |
| Steam to E-201 after D-201 (line 3003), incl. 15.9 t/h turbine exhaust | 251.7 t/h at 135 °C, 3.08 bar(a) |
| E-201 condensate (line 4001) | 251.7 t/h at 134.4 °C, cooled in E-102 to about 82 °C |
| Excess V-201 vapour to E-301 (line 3101) | 20.9 t/h |
| Purge liquor V-201 → V-301 (line 5001) | 47.6 t/h at 125.6 °C |
| V-301 purge evaporator | about 1.01 bar(a), 108.9 °C |
| Purge to disposal well (line 5101) | 6.8 t/h at 108.9 °C |
| Purge-evaporator overheads to E-101 (line 3201) | 25.4 t/h at 100.6 °C after desuperheating |
| Salt produced (dry) | 94.9 t/h (2,511 short t/d) |

The patent describes the FIG. I feed as "saturated in salt" ([US 5,366,514, FIG. I description and Table I](https://patents.google.com/patent/US5366514A/en)).
It explicitly allows lower-concentration feed; solution-mined brine can arrive below saturation. Use `feed_x_NaCl`
to examine that case rather than treating 26 wt % as universal.

## What the patent says about the equipment
- K-201 is a single-wheel centrifugal compressor, 1.8:1, driven by a gas turbine. "The VRC compressor can only pass a
  fixed amount of steam": the vapour above its suction capacity (about 90 % of the boil-up passes it) is the excess sent
  to the purge evaporator heater E-301 (patent col. 7-8).
- Desuperheating condensate is sprayed into the compressor discharge (D-201) because superheated steam transfers heat
  poorly in the large circulating heaters (col. 7).

## Equipment ratings
- K-201 suction capacity: 226.8 t/h (the patent's fixed compressor throughput). Shaft power: not stated in the patent.
- E-201 circulating heater: 8,800 m², U 2,000 W/m²K in service (ILLUSTRATIVE; 2,500 W/m²K clean).
- P-201 forced-circulation pump: 15,000 m³/h rated (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- E-301 purge-evaporator heater: 1,500 m², U 1,500 W/m²K (ILLUSTRATIVE).
- Relief: PSV-201 on V-201 set 3.5 barg, PSV-202 on D-201 set 4.5 barg, PSV-301 on V-301 set 1.0 barg (ours).

## Process requirements and design rules
- Brine temperature rise through E-201 at most 3 K: a larger rise flashes in the tubes and scales them with salt.
- Condensate leaves E-201 saturated at the shell pressure.
- The brine boils above the steam saturation temperature by its boiling point elevation (use the brine_bpe tool).

## Modelling scope (from the plant's process engineer)
- The capacity question is decided by the VRC loop: V-201 boil-up, K-201, D-201 and the circulating heater E-201, plus the
  purge evaporator V-301 with E-301 that takes the excess vapour. Model that loop in detail.
- The feed preheat train (P-101, E-101, E-102) is not in question: take the brine entering V-201 from Table I (264.9 t/h
  at 125.6 °C, plus 98.0 t/h elutriating brine at 60 °C, both scaling with throughput) instead of closing the
  condensate-to-brine heat-recovery loops.
- Turbine exhaust steam joining the compressor discharge: 15.9 t/h at 3.08 bar(a), fixed (the gas turbine does not
  grow with salt production).

## Request
Sales wants the plant to make **3,000 short tons per day instead of 2,500 (+20 %)**.

submit.headline: Yes, with cleaning and extra compression
submit.summary: At 120% (run vrc_120_fixedturb_nofix) the vapour compressor needs 120%, the main heater 111.3% and the purge heater 106.1% of installed area. Cleaning the main heater, adding a 49.5 t/h parallel compressor and holding purge-heater steam at today's rate clears all modelled checks at 120% (run vrc_120_fixedturb_cleanK_E301steamcap), with the main heater at 89.0%, purge heater at 88.4% and the existing compressor at 100%.

highlights.text: Limits first: 272,137 kg/h needed at 120% vs 226,800 kg/h suction capacity (run vrc_120_fixedturb_nofix). Needs a parallel machine; motor itself has headroom (67% after fix).
Main heater needs 9,794 m2 of 8,800 m2 at 120% fouled; cleaning to the documented clean coefficient brings this to 7,836 m2 (89%). Modelled inside unit V-201.
Purge heater needs 1,591 m2 of 1,500 m2 if its steam share grows with feed; holding its steam at today's 20.9 t/h brings this to 1,326 m2 (88%). Modelled inside unit V-301.
With steam held at today's rate its boil-off per tonne of purge falls; no documented minimum boil-off, so this is provisional pending the field check.
Circulation pump and the 3 K brine-rise limit are not in the calibrated model (check_coverage lists P-201/E-201 as grouped into V-201); not verified for 120%.
Modelled only as the turbine-exhaust mixing point in vrc_cal_v2_desup_hx; desuperheating spray duty at 120% is not separately checked.

proposals.title: Clean the main circulating heater back to its clean performance
proposals.why: Cheapest fix first: at 120% the fouled heater needs 9,794 m2 of 8,800 m2; restoring the documented clean coefficient of 2,500 W/m2K drops the need to 7,836 m2 (89%, run vrc_120_fixedturb_cleanK_E301steamcap). No new equipment and no rating is changed.

changes.physical_change: Clean E-201 circulating heater tubes (chemical/mechanical clean during a planned outage) to restore clean heat transfer; E-201 is modelled as the heating side of evaporator unit V-201 in vrc_cal_v2_desup_hx
changes.rating_source: Data sheet Equipment ratings row: E-201 U 2,000 W/m2K in service, 2,500 W/m2K clean (marked ILLUSTRATIVE - confirm achieved clean coefficient by post-clean temperature/flow survey)

proposals.title: Add a small parallel vapour compressor K-202
proposals.why: K-201 is a fixed-throughput machine (data sheet: vapour above its 226.8 t/h suction capacity is the excess vapour). At 120% it is short by about 49.5 t/h; a parallel 55 t/h machine leaves K-201 at its rating and runs itself at 90% flow / 85.5% power (run vrc_120_fixedturb_cleanK_E301steamcap). Existing ratings are untouched.

changes.rating_source: vendor quote to confirm / standard size 55 t/h suction, 2,400 kW shaft at pressure ratio 1.8 (3.08 bar discharge) - proposed rating only, not an existing rating

proposals.title: Hold purge-heater steam at today's rate by trimming the overhead split
proposals.why: Operating change only: reducing the excess-vapour share to the purge heater from 8.44% to 7.03% of the overhead keeps its steam at 20,899 kg/h (today's rate) so its area need stays at 1,326 m2 of 1,500 m2 (88.4%) at 120% feed, instead of 106% with the share unchanged (runs vrc_120_fixedturb_nofix vs vrc_120_fixedturb_cleanK_E301steamcap). The extra vapour instead goes through the new parallel compressor. No rating is changed.

field_checks.item: Clean heat transfer coefficient actually achieved on E-201 after cleaning (documented 2,500 W/m2K is marked ILLUSTRATIVE)
field_checks.where: Post-clean survey on E-201: brine in/out temperatures on lines 2002/2003, condensate temperature on line 4001 and steam flow on line 3003, at steady rate; back-calculate the coefficient
field_checks.changes: If the cleaned coefficient is below about 2,230 W/m2K, the 8,800 m2 installed area is again too small at 120% and a parallel heater would be needed instead of cleaning alone

field_checks.item: Whether the purge evaporator may boil off less per tonne of purge (no minimum boil-off, outlet concentration or disposal limit is documented)
field_checks.where: Confirm with the disposal-well permit / purge specification and measure V-301 liquid outlet concentration and temperature on line 5101 at today's rate
field_checks.changes: If a minimum purge evaporation or maximum disposal rate applies, the split trim is not allowed and E-301 would need added area plus more excess vapour, which would also increase the parallel compressor size

field_checks.item: Circulation rate and brine temperature rise through E-201 at 120% (not in the calibrated model)
field_checks.where: Flow on line 2002 (P-201 discharge, rated 15,000 m3/h on the P&ID) and brine temperatures in lines 2002/2003 to confirm the rise stays within the 3 K data-sheet limit
field_checks.changes: If circulation cannot keep the rise at or below 3 K at 120%, P-201 becomes a fourth limiting item and would need its own proposal

field_checks.item: Installed capacity of purge feed valve 5001/FV-301
field_checks.where: Nameplate / datasheet for valve 5001/FV-301 on line 5001; the model needs a coefficient of 52 at 120% with nothing to compare it against
field_checks.changes: If the installed valve is smaller than the required coefficient at 120%, it becomes a limiting item needing a trim change
